## Why
Explain the longer-term goal and need for multiple stages.

## Outcome
Describe the intended result without claiming unimplemented functionality.

## Scope
List proposed independent stages, dependencies and non-goals. Link existing
Specs and tasks where available; each increment needs its own approval.
